notes.title: Update 3: Companion - Out Now
notes.notes:
[p]Adventurers! The third Lucky Tower Ultimate update is out now! [/p][p][/p][p]This update features a new companion, a new game mode, and more.[/p][p][/p][h3]The Princess[/h3][p]The Princess will be a new companion/enemy hybrid that can be found in the tower.

Winning the community vote for the new companion in March, The Princess can start out as an enemy disguised as a regular princess... but she can be convinced to join the party.

Her loyalty is tied to her hunger. Upon devouring corpses or characters, her mood will improve, and she will eventually join the party and become a companion. But watch out - she'll get hungry again, and she may turn against Von Wanst if she isn't properly fed.

The Princess devours most enemies upon contact, including sleeping monsters, bees, and hammermen.

[/p][h3]Peasant Mode[/h3][p]We are introducing difficulty modes with this update, starting with the Peasant Mode. As you can guess from the name, it's an easier difficulty for those who are not yet ready for the knightliest virtues. It makes the game easier, but some Steam achievements will not be attainable when playing as a peasant.

This new system means we will be able to introduce more difficulty modes sometime in the future, so stay tuned!

If you're eager for a harder mode, let us know what you’d like: More floors? More or harder traps? Less items? Something completely different?

[/p][h3]Auto Hand Switch[/h3][p]Update 3 will include the much requested option to turn off the current "auto-hand-switch." Meaning that Von Wanst will not automatically switch his hands when you grab something.

[b]And more:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New achievements! (Some which can't be achieved in Peasant Mode) [/p][/*][*][p]25 New items and voice lines [/p][/*][*][p]Steam trading cards [/p][/*][*][p]Female Townsfolk[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Good luck persuading The Princess to join your party! notes.title: Update 2: Content - Out Now
notes.notes:
Adventurers! The second Lucky Tower Ultimate milestone update is out now!

This update features content from the community votes, including: 

[h3]The Pipefitter[/h3]
A team of industrious sisters in the village that let you carry more tower items outside. Once you help build an elaborate chute system, you will have a slot in each segment of the tower that you can use for one item. That item will be transported to the next segment in the current run. Once the item is outside, it can be bought in the village at the pipefitter.  

[h3]The Bard[/h3]
You’ll meet a Bard in the village who needs new instruments to impress the townsfolk… who currently hate their music. Fascinated with the musical wonders that you carried outside, the Bard will enter the tower once you’ve fulfilled their quest (to disastrous results). You will then be able to loot their corpse in the tower, which will be located in a random place every run. The corpse contains a new instrument and other useful items. 

[h3]Snowy & Puffles[/h3]
This trap is inspired by one from the original Lucky Tower web game. At the end of a room, you’ll discover three doors with names above them. When you choose one of them and enter a small chamber, the door closes behind you and you’ll face whatever is in it. It might be a harmless snail, a peasant companion, or a tough enemy. You can deduce the room’s contents by the name above the door, which will be combined from a pool of possibilities. 

[h3]The Pipes[/h3]
The tower's sewer system becomes all the more visible with this trap. Unfortunately, the tower has such horrible plumbing that, from time to time, these pipes shake and…
1. Unleash a poisonous cloud into the air

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified & V.0.2.12. Update
notes.notes:
Grab your Steam Deck and dive in for the next escape, because[b] Lucky Tower Ultimate is Steam Deck verified![/b]

We’re super excited to reach this milestone, so thanks to everyone for reporting bugs to help us create a better handheld experience. 

[h2]V.0.2.12. Update:[/h2]

[h3]New Backup System[/h3]

For this update, we added a lot of safety fallbacks and a whole new backup system to keep your files even safer! For most of you, nothing will actually change, but we did implement a few things to ensure the safety of your progress, so here's a short overview:

[h3]Auto Save[/h3]
Since some people reported crashes or weird behavior when using Alt + F4, we implemented a brand new autosave feature. While you're in the village, the game will create a backup every two minutes. This way, even if your computer crashes, your progress should still be saved.

[h3]Daily Backups[/h3]
Your data will now also be saved into a separate daily backup folder. Your most recent save files will be copied into this folder, saving the newest data for the last five consecutive days you've played the game. This is just an additional backup, as long as nothing breaks, you don't need to worry about this folder, but you can use the files to restore your progress if needed!

[h3]Local Backups[/h3]
Before this update, every file was saved in the Steam Cloud, now we're also creating local backups. You don't need to worry about these, it's just an additional safety net. If somehow Steam Cloud messes with your files, you can copy your local files into the proper folder manually and restore what Steam destroyed!

All of these features should help prevent broken or corrupted save files, create regular safety backups, and allow you to manually restore your files in case your computer crashes or Steam Cloud is messing with your files.

Please note, that many people (players and developers alike) have problems with the Steam Cloud sometimes not properly syncing files between different computers. We tried our best to create the best possible backup system for you guys! 

If you’ve been enjoying Lucky Tower Ultimate (and haven’t already), please consider reviewing the game on Steam.

notes.title: Update 1: The Cave - Out Now
notes.notes:
Hey Adventurers, the first Lucky Tower Ultimate Early Access update, “The Cave” is out now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006826/7e2226c1ad1ea520cc4aeeade8e4844628e1b87d.gif[/img]

Here’s what's included in this update:
[list]
[*] The Cave
[*] More than 666 new voice lines
[*] 5+ new achievements
[*] Ultra Widescreen support
[*] New enemy: troll
[*] New village quest
[/list]
[b]What is The Cave?[/b]
The Cave offers an alternative way to escape the tower once you reach the exit door, allowing you to refuse Evelius’s offer and avoid the boss fight. This longer route out of the tower and into the Village will be a dark and atmospheric maze, visually reminiscent of Studio Seufz’s game The Longing. Companions can go insane in these tunnels, so be careful to keep morale high!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41006826/f9ac9b50475251bf25d8149451c9486d7afd68cd.gif[/img]

[h3][url=https://forms.gle/wQiYnS6PNMioQp4q8]Early Access Feedback[/url][/h3]
Please share your Lucky Tower Ultimate feedback with us! We’ve set up a [url=https://forms.gle/wQiYnS6PNMioQp4q8]feedback form[/url] with specific questions and we’d love to hear your thoughts on how we can improve the game for everyone in future updates.

[h3]Steam Bundles[/h3]
There are two bundles now available featuring Lucky Tower Ultimate! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46865/German_Rogues/]German Rogues[/url] includes three roguelikes from Germany: Rack and Slay, Rogue Voltage and Lucky Tower Ultimate. There's also a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46552/Lucky_Tower_x_Gunbrella/]Gunbrella and Lucky Tower Ultimate[/url] bundle with our friends at Devolver! Be sure to check out both bundles.  

Enjoy the new way to escape the tower, we can’t wait to hear your thoughts on the cave and the update.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cave segment added to the tower. It can be found by opening the barred door in the final room of the regular tower
[*] New troll enemy
[*] A hidden treasure room can be found in the caves
[*] Six new types of mushrooms (currently only found in the caves)
[*] Items now react to being hit by stomp traps and anvils. Steel and gold items will be turned into discs that can be used as deadly frisbees. Other items are destroyed or pushed away
[*] New quest in the village: In the castle area, you can talk to a sculptor to request a giant gold statue of yourself. Be warned, this will require a lot of gold...
[/list]
[h3]Quality of Life Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] The UI has been optimized for a lot more resolutions, including Ultra Widescreen
[*] You can now skip the intro by pressing any button twice
[/list]
[h3]New Voice Lines[/h3]

[*] Van Wampe (the red haired knight) now has voice lines
[*] Wanst comments the goodbye lines of companions

[*] New lines for killing Evelius
[*] More lines for Evelius gifting you items
[*] Companion lines for entering the balcony
[*] More idle and small talk lines for Wanst and companions
[*] Townsfolk chatter
[/list]
[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Sobu and Alva no longer immediately attack you when looted (now with new voice lines)
[*] Potion effects now apply to items in the village. However, Wanst will not drink potions while in the village
[*] All cushions in the idea/monkey zone now give different answers, if Evelius asks Wanst a question
The time limit for the monkey selection has been raised to 60 seconds
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed monster render order issues
[*] Fixed Evelius talking at the basement, even though he is dead
[*] Riddle Master cave chest freeze fixed
[*] You can now bring chests back to the tower from outside
[/list]
